name: Arx Apc
axis_orientation: rear-end is negative, front-end is positive
operating_principle: The vehicle operates on an 8x8 wheeled arrangement, providing high mobility and combat effectiveness. The roof weapon station and advanced armor protection enable the vehicle to perform various tasks, including troop transport and fire support.

components.description: The main structural body of the vehicle, providing protection and support for the crew and troops.
A rotating or fixed station that mounts the primary armament, such as a 30mm cannon or machine gun.
The engine and transmission system that powers the vehicle.
The system that transmits power from the engine to the wheels, including axles, gears, and wheel hubs.
The system that connects the wheels to the hull, providing a smooth ride and stability.
The area where troops are transported, including the rear exit door or ramp.
The systems that provide visibility and targeting capabilities for the crew.
Additional protection systems that can be installed to enhance the vehicle's survivability.
